response.sql:
WITH case_averages AS (
  SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS avg_modelconf
  FROM compliancecase
  GROUP BY brokrepstat
), baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(modelconf) AS baseline_avg
  FROM compliancecase
), qualifying AS (
  SELECT ca.brokrepstat, ca.avg_modelconf, b.baseline_avg
  FROM case_averages ca
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE ca.avg_modelconf > b.baseline_avg
), reference AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modelconf) AS qualifying_mean
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT q.brokrepstat AS status,
       q.avg_modelconf,
       q.avg_modelconf - q.baseline_avg AS avg_minus_baseline,
       q.avg_modelconf / r.qualifying_mean AS avg_divided_by_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying q
CROSS JOIN reference r
WHERE q.baseline_avg IS NOT NULL
  AND r.qualifying_mean IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: SQL NULL values in brokrepstat form their own group; AVG ignores NULL modelconf values, and qualifying statuses are those whose non-NULL average is strictly above the case-weighted baseline.
